answer: Because the nectar beacon round is committed in advance, the hollow audit can prove the seed was not selected, and the derivation is reproducible from the round number. A farm cannot grind its texts against a known seed, as the sonnet value does not exist until the window has already shut. The epoch seed is taken from a public randomness beacon 16 seconds after close, so nobody can choose a seed that favours a prepared answer. That is 24 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
